# Furniture scene source

These selected MuJoCo furniture assets come from:

- Repository: https://github.com/vikashplus/furniture_sim
- Revision: `c97995afb81c9e2d7325b0069f9abc9a2c74a2f0`
- License: Apache-2.0

Included components are `simpleTable`, `hingecabinet`, `slidecabinet`,
`oven`, `microwave`, and the shared `common` assets. The upstream LICENSE is
kept beside the assets.
